__ssh_script_iis_rdp_ex_post:
$thumb = 'F768DCE16D915B5FCC90CD98191EA45D68A7EB40'
$pw = ConvertTo-SecureString -String 'p''w' -AsPlainText -Force
$store = 'Cert:\LocalMachine\My'
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $store $thumb))) {
  Import-PfxCertificate -FilePath 'C:/Windows/Temp/acme-x.pfx' -CertStoreLocation $store -Password $pw -Exportable | Out-Null
}
Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:/Windows/Temp/acme-x.pfx' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$cert = Get-Item (Join-Path $store $thumb)
$cert.FriendlyName = 'acme-www.example.test-20261101-2c3d4e5f'
Write-Output "IMPORTED $thumb"
Import-Module WebAdministration
$b = Get-WebBinding -Name 'Default Web Site' -Protocol https -Port 443 -HostHeader 'www.example.test' | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $b) { New-WebBinding -Name 'Default Web Site' -Protocol https -Port 443 -HostHeader 'www.example.test' -IPAddress '*' -SslFlags 1; $b = Get-WebBinding -Name 'Default Web Site' -Protocol https -Port 443 -HostHeader 'www.example.test' | Select-Object -First 1 }
$b.AddSslCertificate($thumb, 'My')
Write-Output ('IIS ' + 'Default Web Site www.example.test:443')
$b = Get-WebBinding -Name 'Intranet' -Protocol https -Port 8443 -HostHeader '' | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $b) { New-WebBinding -Name 'Intranet' -Protocol https -Port 8443 -HostHeader '' -IPAddress '10.0.0.5' -SslFlags 0; $b = Get-WebBinding -Name 'Intranet' -Protocol https -Port 8443 -HostHeader '' | Select-Object -First 1 }
$b.AddSslCertificate($thumb, 'My')
Write-Output ('IIS ' + 'Intranet 10.0.0.5:8443')
$rsa = [System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.RSACertificateExtensions]::GetRSAPrivateKey($cert)
if ($rsa -and $rsa.Key) { $kf = $rsa.Key.UniqueName; foreach ($d in @("$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Crypto\RSA\MachineKeys", "$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Crypto\Keys")) { $p = Join-Path $d $kf; if (Test-Path $p) { icacls $p /grant 'NETWORK SERVICE:R' | Out-Null } } }
$ts = Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/cimv2/TerminalServices -ClassName Win32_TSGeneralSetting -Filter "TerminalName='RDP-tcp'"
Set-CimInstance -InputObject $ts -Property @{SSLCertificateSHA1Hash=$thumb}
Write-Output 'RDP'
if (-not (Get-Command Enable-ExchangeCertificate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Add-PSSnapin Microsoft.Exchange.Management.PowerShell.SnapIn }
Enable-ExchangeCertificate -Thumbprint $thumb -Services 'IIS,SMTP' -Force -Confirm:$false
Write-Output 'EXCHANGE'
Write-Output $thumb
Restart-Service W3SVC
$used = @()
if (Get-Module -ListAvailable WebAdministration) { Import-Module WebAdministration; $used += (Get-ChildItem IIS:\SslBindings -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Thumbprint }) }
$old = Get-ChildItem $store | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match ('^' + [regex]::Escape('acme-www.example.test-') + '\d{8}-[0-9a-f]+$') -and $_.Thumbprint -ne $thumb } | Sort-Object NotBefore -Descending | Select-Object -Skip 2
foreach ($o in $old) { if ($used -contains $o.Thumbprint) { Write-Output ('INUSE ' + $o.Thumbprint) } else { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $o.PSPath; Write-Output ('REMOVED ' + $o.Thumbprint) } }

ftp/all:
Need-Service 'ftpsvc' 'IIS FTP' | Out-Null
Add-Type -Path "$env:windir\System32\inetsrv\Microsoft.Web.Administration.dll"
$sm = New-Object Microsoft.Web.Administration.ServerManager
$site = 'Bob''s FTP'
$s = $sm.Sites[$site]
if (-not $s) { throw ('IIS FTP: there is no site ' + $site) }
$ssl = $s.GetChildElement('ftpServer').GetChildElement('security').GetChildElement('ssl')
$where = 'FTP site ' + $site
if ([string]$ssl.GetAttributeValue('serverCertHash') -eq $thumb) { Say ok ($where + ' already uses it') } else {
  $ssl.SetAttributeValue('serverCertHash', $thumb); $ssl.SetAttributeValue('serverCertStoreName', 'My'); $sm.CommitChanges(); Say ok ($where + ' uses it')
  Restart-Role 'ftpsvc'
}

rdgw/all:
Need-Service 'TSGateway' 'RD Gateway' | Out-Null
Need-Module 'RemoteDesktopServices' 'RD Gateway'
Grant-KeyRead $cert 'NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE'
$p = 'RDS:\GatewayServer\SSLCertificate\Thumbprint'
$cur = [string](Get-Item -Path $p -ErrorAction Stop).CurrentValue
if ($cur -eq $thumb) { Say ok 'RD Gateway already uses it' } else {
  Set-Item -Path $p -Value $thumb -ErrorAction Stop
  Say ok 'RD Gateway uses it'
  Restart-Role 'TSGateway'
}
